# Orchestrator Instruction

- Keep the user as single communication source of truth.
- Require each handoff to include objective, constraints, acceptance criteria, and deliverables.
- Require each return package to include Result Summary, Changed Files, Validation Executed, and Known Risks.
- Do not close tasks with unresolved blockers.
